newsitem.title: UK: LME copper, aluminium end fimer in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper, aluminium end fimer in late trading.

text.p: LME copper moved higher in late inter-office trading on Tuesday but activity was still subdued after the push higher seen in the final minutes of the kerb.
Three months prices were indicated at $2,530/33 at 1803 GMT, building on the late uptick which drove copper to $2,514 a tonne by the kerb, up $26 on the day.
But traders said the final flurry tended to disguise an otherwise drab day's trading, with volumes low-key and interest only patchy.
Aluminium was also firmer after a determined effort to wear down resistance above $1,610. It was indicated at $1,619/21 compared with a close of $1,617, up $14.
